What the contract requires
The first families are Hubble/Cilium, Azure Resource Graph, Kubernetes, Azure Network Watcher and OpenTelemetry.
The boundary
Scope and constraints
Kubernetes Events provide observations. Removing resources absent from an ARG result requires a declared coverage and reconciliation policy.

Adapt Hubble records

Pass native records and their versioned mapping to an injected adapter.
UsageExamples.cs
public static IAsyncEnumerable<AdaptationResult> AdaptHubble(
    IHubbleAdapter adapter, IAsyncEnumerable<NativeInput<HubbleMessage>> flows,
    AdapterDefinition mapping, CancellationToken ct)
{
    // The definition pins the supported native format and mapping version.
    // Results can be observations, withdrawals, loss notices or rejections.
    return adapter.AdaptAsync(flows, mapping, ct);
}
Compile-checked caller example. Execution requires implementations of the injected interfaces.
